name: Before the Fuzz
description: Squashed hard and a little loud, to feed a fuzz or a drive after it a steady level.

name: Country Squash
description: The sustain past half: every pick evened out, the attacks flattened, for clean chicken picking.

name: Endless Sustain
description: Full sustain: a held note lifted as it fades, for clean leads and swells.

name: Funk Rhythm
description: A moderate squash that keeps sixteenth-note strums level and snappy.

name: Gentle Leveller
description: The sustain low: a light hand on the loudest notes, always on.
